title: Daily digest: Miyapur cop sentenced to 4 weeks in jail | 73.3L voters excluded in Telangana, hard | 30 missing terrorists from Reasi exfiltr
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Miyapur cop sentenced to 4 weeks in jail, fined Rs 2k for contempt.
73.3L voters excluded in Telangana, hardly 1k file fresh forms.
30 missing terrorists from Reasi exfiltrated to Pakistan for arms training.
bullets_ur: Miyapur ka police ahalkar toheen-e-adalat par 4 hafte qaid aur 2 hazaar rupey jurmanay ka shikar.
Telangana mein 73.3L vote kharij, mushkil se 1k ne naye form jama karaye.
Reasi se farar honay walay 30 dehshtgard asla ki tarbiyat ke liye Pakistan muntaqil ho gaye.
